consumers.requiredChange: Govern field kind, bounds, root/update obligations and initialization-before-publication; future generational barrier remains separate

proofDuties.premises: Normal/task/internal coverage; finite width/range and overflow proofs; injective PointId resolver within artifact/domain generation

proofDuties.premises: Actual C memory-order/lock proof; collector admission; root registration cannot race allocating setup; unknown readers refused
proofDuties.counterexample: Scanner sees publish bit before last GC map or root write

proofDuties.leanLaw: Binding observations and errors match old ordered producer/consumer trace; every live temporary is rooted
proofDuties.premises: Process/global/VM scope decision; actual interner/global consumer census; irreversible effects are not rollbackable
proofDuties.counterexample: Early SETUP_FIXUP_DONE followed by failure misread as successful retry or shared blueprint mutated by second owner

proofDuties.leanLaw: Source liveness plus map/coordinate correctness plus final handoff implies no live root omitted; scanner preserves identity

migration.change: Split immutable ModuleSpec from resolved image/binding instances; expose entered/completed state and custody
migration.retiringRole: In-place source-blueprint fixups and global FIXUP_DONE-as-only-progress protocol
migration.gate: Binding/global scope, all fixrefs, allocation roots, recursion and failure semantics admitted

migration.change: Generate one frame encoder/decoder and explicit PointId resolver; migrate all selected frame readers and writers
migration.retiringRole: DEF_LBL_RET/DEF_OFD/IFD/OFD and implicit OFD table cursor policy at fully migrated roles

migration.change: Publish ready native binding separately from Scheme stage completion; preserve native setup/init/thunk sequence

migration.gate: Tail calls, roots, stage/exception/effect observations, preload/dynamic modes and diagnostics accepted

migration.change: Remove duplicate encoder/layout owners and obsolete compatibility adapters per migrated role
migration.retiringRole: Old count-controlled layout and frame access paths only when full consumer closure permits
migration.gate: Regenerate required bootstraps; audit inline C/FFI and external artifacts; no indefinite dual representation; native gates remain future work
migration.cost: Temporary adapter cost tracked separately; old artifacts explicitly supported by adapter or rejected

gains.removedWork: Repeated manual layout definitions and per-module invariant macro construction
gains.addedWork: One generated layout policy, validation and target-identity tracking
gains.metric: Definition owners per layout fact: current at least Scheme+C -> proposed one authored owner; repeated frontend tokens and invalidated actions
gains.positiveCondition: Generator actually replaces old definitions and all consumers; no shadow hand-maintained header
gains.refutation: Generated files merely duplicate still-required old policy or expand the same macro body per TU

gains.removedWork: Per-TU parsing/diagnostic work moved into shared invariant helpers and compact descriptors
gains.addedWork: Helper calls or inlining, relocations, table loads, metadata cache pressure
gains.metric: Total tokens/AST nodes and peak compiler memory; cold/no-change/leaf/macro critical path
gains.positiveCondition: Removed compiler work exceeds generator/validation and any runtime overhead satisfies runtime budgets
gains.refutation: All helpers inline into same-size text or descriptors increase hot-loop latency more than budget

gains.removedWork: Drift between Scheme liveness, encoded maps and consumer coordinates
gains.addedWork: Validation, roots, post-GC reload and governed frame writes
gains.metric: Duplicate map/layout interpretations removed; actual root coverage and per-GC scan work measured separately later
gains.positiveCondition: One policy interpreter removes duplicate support while retaining precise scan semantics
gains.refutation: Blindly scanning fewer mature frames without proven barrier/write closure; no GC speedup follows from binding generation

gains.removedWork: Repeated immutable descriptor reconstruction or unsafe shared fixup ownership
gains.addedWork: Per-domain state, synchronization, leases, fresh interning/binding as required
gains.metric: Immutable bytes shared versus per-instance bytes; setup work, contention and failure-retained bytes
gains.positiveCondition: Blueprint sharing is real and private-state/synchronization overhead remains bounded
gains.refutation: More per-instance copies than saved preparation; required instantiation cannot be cached away

gains.removedWork: Handwritten mechanical declarations/adapters and ad hoc offset tracking
gains.addedWork: Extractor/compiler dependencies, target manifests, wrapper code and equivalence maintenance
gains.metric: Old declarations retired; generator executions per relevant ABI identity, added invalidation fanout
gains.positiveCondition: Batch generation cached at complete ABI cut; target compiler owns final C representation
gains.refutation: Run libclang over macro-heavy header for every module; trust Clang layout for GCC without evidence

gains.removedWork: Independent semantic rediscovery in future C/LLVM/MLIR/Zig encoders
gains.addedWork: Each admitted encoder plus its target/runtime semantic refinement
gains.metric: Number of semantic/layout facts with one owner; duplicated semantic branches and adapter counts
gains.positiveCondition: All backends consume completed contracts; each replaces a role or delivers separately demonstrated capability
gains.refutation: Second language requires same semantics rewritten and both runtimes permanently maintained without gain
